IP Address Options

Reserve public IP addresses for your Azure Cloud Services deployments.

commonSections.content:
Cloud Services

Deploy highly available, massively scalable applications and APIs.

• Create highly-available, infinitely-scalable cloud applications and APIs

    • Azure Cloud Services is a Platform as a Service (PaaS) technology engineered to deploy applications that are scalable, reliable, and inexpensive to operate. With Cloud Services, you can focus on your applications, not on the underlying cloud infrastructure.
    • Standard egress charges apply. Cloud Services (extended support) use Azure Key Vault and Basic (ARM) Public IP addresses . Customers requiring certificates need to use Azure Key Vault for certificate management. Each Public IP address for Cloud Services (extended support) are charged separately.

FAQ

Expand All
  • If my deployed instance is in the “stopped” state, am I still billed?

    Yes. A stopped instance still occupies the computing resources that provide support for the instance, so you will still be charged. In order to stop billing, you need to delete your deployment.

  • If my web or worker role was deployed for less than an hour, how much will I be charged?

    Cloud Services are billed based on the length of time your service was deployed for. If your instance was deployed for less than 1 hour, or several hours plus some minutes that do not add up to 1 hour, you will be charged only for that duration. Azure does not round up partial hours to full hours for billing – you only need to pay for the actual time that your Cloud Services instance was in a “running” state.

  • How are different instance sizes billed?

    As described in the table below, all standard Cloud Services hours are converted to small (A1) instance hours on the bills shown to you. For example, a one-hour medium (A2) Cloud Services instance will appear as a two-hour small (A1) Cloud Services instance on the bill that is shown to you.

    Cloud Services instance Hours Small instance hours
    Extra small (A0) 1 1/4 hour
    Small (A1) 1 1 hour
    Medium (A2) 1 2 hours
    Large (A3) 1 4 hours
    Extra large (A4) 1 8 hours
  • Do the above prices include tax?

    Yes, the prices listed include tax

Support & SLA

If you have any questions or need help, please visit Azure Support and select self-help service or any other method to contact us for support.

For Cloud Services, we guarantee that when you deploy two or more role instances in different fault domains and upgrade domains, Internet-facing roles will be able to establish external connections at least 99.95% of the time. If you want to learn more about the details of our Service Level Agreement, please visit the Service Level Agreement page.
